newsitem.title: USA: IVAX customer inventories remained up in Q3.
newsitem.headline: IVAX customer inventories remained up in Q3.

text.p: IVAX Corp said Monday that several factors relating to IVAX' U.S. generic drug business adversely affected its 1996 third quarter results, including the fact that customer inventory levels continued to be high, depressing customer re-orders.
The company also said reserves for returns and inventory write-offs were well above those of typical quarters.
The aggregate adverse effect of these factors was significantly greater than IVAX anticipated when it offered its September 30 earnings estimate, the company said.
In the third quarter, IVAX said it supplemented its existing second quarter reserve of about $6 million with additional reserves of about $7 million.

In a separate news release Monday, IVAX said it executed a definitive merger agreement with Bergen Brunswig Corp, a pharmaceutical and hospital products distributor, which would form the nation's only fully-integrated manufacturer and distributor of products to the pharmaceutical and acute care communities.

IVAX said its third quarter results include a $104.3 million pre-tax charge relating to the writedown of goodwill and certain fixed assets of its U.S. generic drug distribution business and certain product lines of its specialty chemicals business.
Due to the recent financial performance of those businesses, the company said the value of certain assets was not recoverable and, accordingly, IVAX wrote off these amounts in the 1996 third quarter.

Of the $104.3 million charge, $55.9 million relates to IVAX's U.S. generic drug distribution business and $48.5 million relates to certain product lines of its specialty chemicals businesses, the company said.

The writedowns will reduce depreciation and amortization expenses by about $1.1 million in the 1996 fourth quarter and by about $3.7 million annually, and will increase annual net income by about $4.3 million, IVAX said.
As previously announced, IVAX said it incurred a pre-tax charge of $14.0 million in the 1996 third quarter relating to a corporate restructuring initiated in the third quarter.
